excellent.en: She received excellent results in her final exam.
excellent.zh: 她在期末考试中取得了优异的成绩。

excellent.en: The hotel provides excellent service to every guest.
excellent.zh: 这家酒店为每位客人提供极好的服务。

excellent.en: He is an excellent teacher who makes difficult ideas easy to understand.
excellent.zh: 他是一位出色的老师，能把难懂的概念讲得简单易懂。

excellent.en: Your English has made excellent progress this term.
excellent.zh: 这学期你的英语取得了很大的进步。

outstanding.en: Her outstanding performance won the judges' praise.
outstanding.zh: 她杰出的表现赢得了评委们的赞扬。

outstanding.en: He has an outstanding ability to solve complex problems.
outstanding.zh: 他拥有解决复杂问题的卓越能力。

outstanding.en: The company recognized her outstanding contribution to the project.
outstanding.zh: 公司表彰了她对项目作出的杰出贡献。

outstanding.en: Several outstanding issues still need to be discussed.
outstanding.zh: 还有几个尚未解决的问题需要讨论。

brilliant.en: She came up with a brilliant solution to the problem.
brilliant.zh: 她想出了一个解决这个问题的绝妙办法。

brilliant.en: The scientist made a brilliant discovery at a young age.
brilliant.zh: 这位科学家年轻时就取得了一项杰出的发现。

brilliant.en: The room was filled with brilliant sunlight.
brilliant.zh: 房间里洒满了明亮的阳光。
他出色的表现给所有人留下了深刻印象。
